class.name: PythonScreenServer
class.brief_description: Cab screens drawn by the original engine's Python 2 and 3 scripts.
class.description: The [code]pyscreen:[/code] of an MMD. A script is a class named after its file, built with the directory it lives in; each update hands it a dictionary of the train state, [code]render()[/code] returns an RGBA buffer and [code]getCommands()[/code] the commands the screen sends back to the train ([code]PyInt.cpp:23-224[/code]). CPython runs in processes of their own, [code]maszyna-python-host[/code]: one for a Python 3 runtime (3.14 or later) and one for a 2.7 runtime, side by side. A runtime is the game's own beside the host ([code]python3.NN/[/code], [code]python2.7/[/code]), else the game directory's, as the original loads it ([code]maszyna/python/home[/code] for 2.7). A script runs on 3.x when it compiles and loads there, on 2.7 otherwise, and on 2.7 when no 3.x runtime is found; one that fails on 3.x while it is made or draws - written for 2.7 and the Pillow of its time - runs on 2.7 from then on. Each host has the base classes of its runtime ([code]abstractscreenrenderer.py[/code]) first in its search path. Nothing a runtime does can end the game: when a host ends - a fatal Python error, a crash in an extension module, a runtime that is missing - what it printed and its exit code go to the log, [signal python_runtime_failed] is emitted once and its screens stay blank. One worker thread a host talks to it, a request at a time. Each screen has an instance of its script's class of its own.

method.name: screen_create
method.description: A screen drawn by the script at [param script_path] - its absolute path without [code].py[/code]; [param commands_received] is called with the commands the script returns ([PackedStringArray]), on the main thread.

method.name: screen_get_average_color
method.description: The average colour of the last frame the screen's script drew (black before the first) - what the screen throws around it.

method.name: screen_get_texture
method.description: The texture of [param screen] - a blank one until the script has drawn the first frame.

method.name: screen_request_render
method.description: Queues a render of [param screen] with [param state]; a render still waiting for the same screen is replaced, not repeated ([code]python_taskqueue::insert()[/code]).

signal.name: python_runtime_failed
signal.description: The Python host process (maszyna-python-host) has ended - the runtime is missing or broken, or a script brought the interpreter down - and the screens stay blank until the game is restarted. [param message] is what the host printed on its way out and its exit code; it is in the log too. Emitted once.

signal.name: screen_rendered
signal.description: A frame the script drew reached the screen's texture.
